$description: Rhythm and adjacency rules JSON Schema cannot express. Every rule is enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py; the rule ids here and the check ids there are the same strings and verify_all.py fails if they diverge.

rules.rule: At most one section of category `hero` may appear in nodes[].
rules.exceptionEvidence: page.not-found composes only error.not-found; page.contact composes only contact.minimal; page.captured-plate composes only plate sections and its h1 is nominated at runtime from the largest heading in the first two sections. None of the three contains a `hero`-category node, so a blanket rule would either reject them or silently pass a hero-less page as correct. src/pages/CapturedPage.jsx:55-63

rules.rule: If a `hero`-category section is present it must be nodes[0].
chrome.navbar and chrome.footer must NEVER appear in a PageSpec's nodes[].
rules.evidence: App.jsx renders <Navbar/> and <Footer/> ONCE, outside <Routes>, with every page a child of <main>. Checked against the real file rather than assumed: a rule saying the navbar must be the first node would be wrong for every template in this repo. src/App.jsx:32-92

rules.rule: No node's motion.pattern may be a scroll-reveal, fade-up, scroll-progress scrub or hero entrance.
rules.evidence: ScrollTrigger.getAll() returns []; a computed-style census finds zero elements with animation-name != none; elements at opacity 0 are inactive carousel slides. An earlier version of this clone invented a fade-up system and it was removed. HANDOFF.md:75-78

rules.rule: Every node's motion object must carry a reducedMotionFallback from the closed enum.
rules.evidence: A global prefers-reduced-motion rule clamps animation and transition durations to 0.01ms. src/index.css:160-165

rules.rule: A section whose contract sets constraints.onePerPage may appear at most once, keyed on (section, variant) — not on the bare id.
rules.evidence: careers.statement-band legitimately uses the same 120/600 treatment twice on /careers, so a bare-id check would false-positive. src/pages/Careers.jsx:48-58

rules.rule: nodes[] must be checked AGAINST the PageSpec's declared `template`: every node must be listed in that template, every required node of that template must be present, and order must be a subsequence of the template's own order. A repeatable node may appear more than once.
rules.evidence: This is the single most repeated design-repo bug class — a validator that checks nodes[] in isolation lets a PageSpec contradict its own template and still pass.

rules.rule: Sections whose contract sets constraints.homeRouteOnly may only appear on page.home.
Sections whose contract sets constraints.routeOnly may only appear on a PageSpec whose route is in that list.
captured.* sections may only appear on page.captured-plate, and no non-captured body section may appear there apart from the three AUTO()-spliced interactive replacements.
When conversion.cta-band or conversion.product-cta-panel is present it should be the last node.
rules.exceptionEvidence: page.pricing genuinely closes on faq.accordion and carries no CTA band at all — verified against the real node sequence in Pricing.jsx before this rule was written, not assumed. src/pages/Pricing.jsx:160-162

rules.rule: Two consecutive nodes should not share a category.
rules.exceptionEvidence: Every pair above is a REAL adjacency in a real template's node sequence, read off the component that renders it. The rule exists to catch a generator stapling unrelated blocks together, not to reject the site's own rhythm.

rules.rule: At most 4 nodes per page may carry a motion.pattern other than `none`.
rules.evidence: The busiest real page is page.home with 6 moving bands; every other live template has 0-2. The budget is set at 4 with page.home exempted so a generated page cannot out-animate the site.

rules.rule: Every media-bearing field must be an object carrying an assetRole from the closed enum in assets/asset-roles.json.
